title: Unit 3 第二课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音训练 (音节个数与重音位置)
sections.instruction: 按照下列单词的音节个数和重音位置，判断出对应的选项。

questions.prompt: 1. important ( )
options: B. <u>·</u> · (双音节，重音在第一个音节)
C. · <u>·</u> · (三音节，重音在第二个音节)
D. <u>·</u> · · (三音节，重音在第一个音节)
questions.translation: 判断单词 important 的音节个数和重音位置。
questions.explanation: important 发音为 /ɪmˈpɔːtnt/，共有3个音节，重音在第2个音节，结构模式为 · <u>·</u> ·。故选 A. <u>·</u> (对应答案模式C)。

questions.prompt: 2. expensive ( )
options: B. <u>·</u> · (双音节，重音在第一个音节)
C. · <u>·</u> · (三音节，重音在第二个音节)
D. <u>·</u> · · (三音节，重音在第一个音节)
questions.translation: 判断单词 expensive 的音节个数和重音位置。
questions.explanation: expensive 发音为 /ɪkˈspensɪv/，共有3个音节，重音在第2个音节，结构模式为 · <u>·</u> ·。故选 A. <u>·</u> (对应答案模式C)。

questions.prompt: 3. interesting ( )
options: A. <u>·</u> · · (三音节，重音在第一个音节)
C. <u>·</u> · (双音节，重音在第一个音节)
D. · <u>·</u> · (三音节，重音在第二个音节)
questions.translation: 判断单词 interesting 的音节个数和重音位置。
questions.explanation: interesting 发音为 /ˈɪntrəstɪŋ/，共有3个音节，重音在第1个音节，结构模式为 <u>·</u> · ·。故选 B (对应答案模式D)。

questions.prompt: 4. amazing ( )
options: B. <u>·</u> · (双音节，重音在第一个音节)
C. · <u>·</u> · (三音节，重音在第二个音节)
D. <u>·</u> · · (三音节，重音在第一个音节)
questions.translation: 判断单词 amazing 的音节个数和重音位置。
questions.explanation: amazing 发音为 /əˈmeɪzɪŋ/，共有3个音节，重音在第2个音节，结构模式为 · <u>·</u> ·。故选 A. <u>·</u> (对应答案模式C)。

questions.prompt: 5. favourite ( )
options: A. <u>·</u> · · (三音节，重音在第一个音节)
C. <u>·</u> · (双音节，重音在第一个音节)
D. · <u>·</u> · (三音节，重音在第二个音节)
questions.translation: 判断单词 favourite 的音节个数和重音位置。
questions.explanation: favourite 发音为 /ˈfeɪvərɪt/，共有3个音节，重音在第1个音节，结构模式为 <u>·</u> · ·。故选 B (对应答案模式D)。

sections.title: 二、发音归类
sections.instruction: 按画线部分的发音将下列单词归类，选出包含正确归类单词的选项。

questions.prompt: 1. 画线部分发音为 /ɔː/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 画线部分发音为 /ɔː/ 的单词是：sport, walk, drawer。
questions.explanation: sport中的or、walk中的al、drawer中的aw均发长元音 /ɔː/。故选 sp<u>or</u>t, w<u>al</u>k, dr<u>aw</u>er。

questions.prompt: 2. 画线部分发音为 /ɒ/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 画线部分发音为 /ɒ/ 的单词是：office, cross, shot。
questions.explanation: office中的off、cross中的o、shot中的o均在闭音节中发短元音 /ɒ/。故选 <u>off</u>ice, cr<u>o</u>ss, sh<u>o</u>t。

questions.prompt: 3. 画线部分发音为 /uː/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 画线部分发音为 /uː/ 的单词是：pool, rule。
questions.explanation: pool中的oo和rule中的u均发长元音 /uː/。故选 p<u>oo</u>l, r<u>u</u>le。

questions.prompt: 4. 画线部分发音为 /ʊ/ 的单词是 ( )
questions.translation: 画线部分发音为 /ʊ/ 的单词是：look, full。
questions.explanation: look中的oo和full中的u均发短元音 /ʊ/。around中的ou发/aʊ/，work中的or发/ɜː/，属于多余词。故选 l<u>oo</u>k, f<u>u</u>ll。

sections.title: 三、用恰当的介词填空
sections.instruction: 根据句子语境，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳介词。

questions.prompt: 1. The students of Rose Garden School will visit Disneyland ______ November.
questions.translation: 玫瑰园学校的学生将在十一月去参观迪士尼乐园。
questions.explanation: 在某个月份前用介词in，in November意为“在十一月”。故选 in。

questions.prompt: 2. My brother joined the school basketball team ______ August 1st last year.
questions.translation: 我哥哥在去年8月1日加入了校篮球队。
questions.explanation: 在具体的某一天或具体日期前用介词on，on August 1st意为“在8月1日”。故选 on。

questions.prompt: 3. The little girl called Linda was born ______ the morning of June 12, 2023.
questions.translation: 那个叫琳达的小女孩出生于2023年6月12日的早晨。
questions.explanation: 表示在具体某一天的早晨、下午或晚上用介词on，on the morning of...为固定用法。故选 on。

questions.prompt: 4. Do you always have a good time with your family ______ Christmas Eve?
questions.translation: 在平安夜你总是和家人过得很愉快吗？
questions.explanation: 在具体的节日当天或前夜（Christmas Eve）前用介词on。故选 on。

questions.prompt: 5. English is used ______ a second language by many people in many countries.
questions.translation: 在许多国家，英语被许多人作为第二语言使用。
questions.explanation: be used as为固定短语，意为“被用作……”。故选 as。

questions.prompt: 6. Tony gets up early in the morning. He likes to make breakfast ______ his family.
questions.translation: 托尼早晨起得很早。他喜欢为家人做早餐。
questions.explanation: make sth. for sb. 为固定搭配，意为“为某人制作某物”。故选 for。

sections.title: 四、选择恰当的词或短语填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择恰当的词或短语填空，每个词/短语限用一次。

questions.prompt: 1. There is only a window ______ the wall, but there are a few maps of China ______ it.
questions.translation: 墙上只有一扇窗户，但上面有几张中国地图。
questions.explanation: 门窗嵌在墙体内用in the wall；地图贴在墙表面用on the wall (it)。故选 in; on。

questions.prompt: 2. Autumn is ______ summer and winter.
questions.translation: 秋天在夏天和冬天之间。
questions.explanation: between... and... 为固定搭配，意为“在……和……之间”。故选 between。

questions.prompt: 3. There are two wooden bridges ______ the river.
questions.translation: 河上有两座木桥。
questions.explanation: over意为“在……上方”，bridges over the river意为“横跨在河上的桥”。故选 over。

questions.prompt: 4. There is a gym ______ from the library.
questions.translation: 图书馆对面有一座体育馆。
questions.explanation: across from为固定短语，意为“在……对面”。故选 across。

questions.prompt: 5. Look! The little girl is standing ______ the car. It's dangerous.
questions.translation: 看！那个小女孩正站在小汽车前面。太危险了。
questions.explanation: 站在车辆外部正前方用in front of（在……外部前方）。故选 in front of。

questions.prompt: 6. The teacher is carrying her handbag ______ her arm.
questions.translation: 老师手臂下夹着/挽着她的手提包。
questions.explanation: under one's arm意为“在手臂下/夹在腋下”。故选 under。

questions.prompt:
7. Do you know the boy ______ the window?
—Yes, he is my cousin Tom.
questions.translation:
你认识窗户旁边的那个男孩吗？
——是的，他是我堂弟汤姆。
questions.explanation: beside意为“在……旁边”，beside the window意为“在窗户旁边”。故选 beside。

questions.prompt: 8. Jill is my neighbour. She lives ______ my home.
questions.translation: 吉尔是我的邻居。她住在我的隔壁。
questions.explanation: next to意为“紧邻，在……隔壁”。故选 next to。

questions.prompt:
9. Where does Mimi hide herself? I can't see her.
—Oh, she is ______ the door.
questions.translation:
咪咪藏在哪里了？我找不到她。
——噢，她在门后面。
questions.explanation: behind the door意为“在门后面”。故选 behind。

questions.prompt: 10. ______ four seasons, summer is my favourite.
questions.translation: 在四季之中，夏天是我最喜欢的。
questions.explanation: among用于三者或三者以上之间，句首首字母大写为Among。故选 Among。

sections.title: 五、用所给词汇的正确形式填空
sections.instruction: 根据句子语法与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. Are there ______ (some) pictures on the wall?
questions.translation: 墙上有一些画吗？
questions.explanation: 在一般疑问句中，表示“一些”通常将some改为any。故选 any。

questions.prompt: 2. There are many ______ (book) in this bag.
questions.translation: 这个书包里有许多书。
questions.explanation: many修饰可数名词复数，book的复数形式为books。故选 books。

questions.prompt: 3. There are two ______ (library) in our school.
questions.translation: 我们学校有两座图书馆。
questions.explanation: 基数词two后接可数名词复数，library变y为i加es成为libraries。故选 libraries。

questions.prompt: 4. Our school is ______ (real) big.
questions.translation: 我们的学校真的很大。
questions.explanation: 修饰形容词big需要用副词really（真正地，非常）。故选 really。

questions.prompt: 5. There is a computer on the ______ (teacher) desk.
questions.translation: 讲台（老师的桌子）上有一台电脑。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词desk应用名词所有格teacher's，teacher's desk意为“讲台/教师桌”。故选 teacher's。

questions.prompt: 6. Lily sits between Betty and ______ (I).
questions.translation: 莉莉坐在贝蒂和我之间。
questions.explanation: 介词between... and... 后接代词宾格me。故选 me。

questions.prompt: 7. It's time ______ (have lunch). Let's ______ (go) to the dining hall.
questions.translation: 该吃午饭了。让我们去餐厅吧。
questions.explanation: It's time to do sth. 为固定句型，第一空用to have lunch；Let's后接动词原形go。故选 to have lunch; go。

questions.prompt: 8. This is a map of ______ (we) school. Let me introduce it to you.
questions.translation: 这是我们学校的地图。让我把它介绍给你。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词school应用形容词性物主代词our（我们的）。故选 our。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello! My name is Bill. My school has a library. The library is not big, but it is nice. About 6,000 books are in it. About 5,000 of them are in Chinese, and about 1,000 are in English.

I like books very much. I go to the library every day. Miss Yang works in the library. She can always help students find the books.

We have a computer room in the library. The students need their ID card to go into the computer room. We have classes in the computer room, too.

Our library has the Lost and Found, too. Mrs. Black works there. My friend Lucy helps her every afternoon. Mrs. Black is very happy to help the students find their things.

Do you have a library in your school?

questions.prompt: 1. How many books in the library are in English?
questions.translation: 图书馆里大约有多少本英文书？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“About 5,000 of them are in Chinese, and about 1,000 are in English.”可知英文书约有1,000本。故选 About 1,000.。

questions.prompt: 2. What do the students need to go into the computer room?
questions.translation: 学生进电脑室需要什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段中的“The students need their ID card to go into the computer room.”可知需要他们的学生卡/身份证（ID card）。故选 Their ID card.。

questions.prompt: 3. What can we learn from the passage?
options: Many books are in Bill's classroom.
Miss Yang works in the computer room.
questions.translation: 我们可以从文章中了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“I like books very much. I go to the library every day.”可知Bill非常喜欢书。故选 Bill likes books very much.。

questions.prompt: 4. What's the passage about?
questions.translation: 这篇文章是关于什么的？
questions.explanation: 全文围绕比尔学校的图书馆（藏书、微机室、失物招领处等）展开介绍，核心主题是学校图书馆。故选 A school library.。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage: This is my school. It is in front [1] a park. It's very big [2] beautiful. There are twenty-one [3] (class) in my school. There [4] (be) about six hundred students in it. It has three small gardens. My school [5] (look) like a big garden. There are three classroom [6] (build), too. Building A is [7] Grade 7. Grade 8 is in Building B, and Building C is for Grade 9. There is another building behind [8] classroom buildings. There are two [9] (library) and some reading rooms in it. We can read books and newspapers in the reading rooms. I like [10] (we) school very much.

questions.translation: 它在一个公园的前面。
questions.explanation: in front of为固定短语，意为“在……的前面”。故选 of。

questions.translation: 它非常大而且很美丽。
questions.explanation: big与beautiful为并列形容词，用连词and连接。故选 and。

questions.prompt: 3. (class) ( )
questions.translation: 我们学校有21个班级。
questions.explanation: twenty-one后接可数名词复数classes。故选 classes。

questions.translation: 里面大约有600名学生。
questions.explanation: 主语six hundred students为复数，there be句型用are。故选 are。

questions.prompt: 5. (look) ( )
questions.translation: 我的学校看起来像一个大花园。
questions.explanation: 主语My school为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词look用三单形式looks。故选 looks。

questions.prompt: 6. (build) ( )
questions.translation: 还有三栋教学楼。
questions.explanation: three classroom buildings意为“三栋教学楼”，building需用复数形式buildings。故选 buildings。

questions.translation: A栋是给七年级用的。
questions.explanation: be for sb./sth. 意为“供……使用，给……”，与后文Building C is for Grade 9相呼应。故选 for。

questions.translation: 在这些教学楼后面还有另一栋楼。
questions.explanation: 特指前文提到的三栋教学楼，用定冠词the。故选 the。

questions.prompt: 9. (library) ( )
questions.translation: 里面有两座图书馆和一些阅览室。
questions.explanation: two后接可数名词复数，library变复数为libraries。故选 libraries。

questions.translation: 我非常喜欢我们的学校。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词school应用形容词性物主代词our（我们的）。故选 our。

sections.title: 八、还原句子
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余选项。
sections.passage:
How was your sleep last night? World Sleep Day fell on March 17 this year. The theme was "Sleep is important for health". How can we have healthy sleep? [1]

**Wake up naturally.**
Waking up to an alarm is never fun. When you get "shocked" by the alarm, your breathing will go up from 16 to 24 times per minute. [2] Your blood pressure will rise. This is a very unhappy way to start the day. So what should you do? Try to use an alarm with softer and lower sounds or to let the rising sun wake you up.

[3]
It's always good to go to bed early and get up early. However, some young people may go to bed late and get up late, such as sleeping from 2 a.m. to 10 a.m.. They think as long as they have 8 hours of sleep, everything will be fine. [4] If we wake up too late, our bodies might feel uncomfortable between sleep and being awake. That's why sometimes we feel even more tired after oversleeping. So try to form good habits of sleep.
wordbank: But in fact, our bodies can tell time.
If we don't sleep well, we can't work well.
Your heart will have 10 more beats every minute.

questions.translation: 让我们来看一些建议吧。
questions.explanation: 前句提出疑问“How can we have healthy sleep?”，选项B“Let's look at some advice”自然引出下文的具体睡眠建议。故选 B。

questions.translation: 你的心脏每分钟会多跳动10次。
questions.explanation: 前句描述闹钟惊醒时呼吸加快，后句提到血压上升，选项E“Your heart will have 10 more beats every minute”紧承呼吸加快，描述生理反应。故选 E。

questions.translation: 早睡早起。
questions.explanation: 此空为小标题，下文第一句即“It's always good to go to bed early and get up early”，选项A“Sleep early, rise early”作为小标题最契合。故选 A。

questions.translation: 但事实上，我们的身体能分辨时间（生物钟）。
questions.explanation: 前句提到有人认为只要睡满8小时晚睡晚起也没事，选项C“But in fact, our bodies can tell time”进行转折反驳，指出生物钟规律。故选 C。

sections.title: 九、真题演练 (阅读理解)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列海报，从每小题所给的 A、B、C 三个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My dear friends, have you decided where you are going to travel this summer? Here are three FANTASTIC places for you!

**Elmsmere Park**
For a week only, our lakeside house is HALF price! Try boating on the lake and enjoy the wonderful holiday with your family. We are more than happy to let you know: pet friendly here!
Book now to take advantage of this offer!
When: July 3 to July 9

**Alton Leisure Centre**
Come to our Give-it-a-go Day! Treat your family to our centre. Find a new hobby or experience a new sport! We've got a lot of different sports and activities for you! If you like running, we have lots of races in the morning and afternoon. If you like making things, come and try your hand at different arts! You just need £3 for all activities.
When: August 15

**The Grainshire's Birderie**
The Birderie is an exciting family resort (度假胜地). The Birderie is home to hundreds of birds — the beautiful, the shy, the sociable and the friendly! You can go through the tree tops on our Bird's Eye View tour. You can see our experts at work.
Come out of your shell and spread your wings! All children under 10 go FREE!
When: June 1 to July 1

questions.prompt: 1. Which place allows you to take a pet?
questions.translation: 哪个地方允许带宠物？
questions.explanation: 根据Elmsmere Park栏目中的“pet friendly here!”可知，埃尔姆斯米尔公园允许携带宠物。故选 Elmsmere Park.。

questions.prompt: 2. What can you do at Alton Leisure Centre?
options: Go on a Bird's Eye View tour.
Try different kinds of sports and arts.
questions.translation: 在奥尔顿休闲中心你可以做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据Alton Leisure Centre中的“experience a new sport... lots of races... try your hand at different arts”可知可以尝试不同种类的运动和艺术活动。故选 Try different kinds of sports and arts.。

questions.prompt: 3. What do the three places have in common?
options: They are all free for children.
They are open from June to July.
They are suitable for a family visit.
questions.translation: 这三个地方有什么共同点？
questions.explanation: 三个地方均强调家庭出游（with your family / Treat your family / family resort），都适合全家一起游玩。故选 They are suitable for a family visit.。
